verdicts.reason: A separates the circle from the can: the empty green circle is orphaned and cropped at the far left, and the can is a tiny sliver far right. The headline sits above the SOLSTICE wordmark, which reverses the original order, and the body copy is too small to read. All the text is packed into the left-centre with dead space around it. B keeps the can inside its circle and the brand → headline → body order with readable copy, but the CTA has been squashed into a cramped circle at the right edge. It overlaps both badges, its label is tiny, and the badges outweigh it, so the CTA is buried and collides with them.
